blocks.title: Modelica as the Language of System Engineering

content.text: At iVH, system engineering is built around **Modelica.**
More than just a modeling tool, Modelica is a specialized system engineering language capable of representing complex industrial systems through a single, unified framework.

Representing Korea, iVH actively participates in the **Modelica Association.** We lead the evolution of this technology alongside the global community by hosting the **Modelica International and Asian Modelica Conferences.**
Furthermore, iVH serves as a **Board-level contributor** to the Modelica Association, directly influencing international standards and the future strategic direction of the technology.
iVH does not stop at simply "following" standards.
We implement Modelica as a tangible engineering practice within real-world industrial environments.
Through these pivotal roles, iVH bridges the gap between theoretical standards and practical engineering.
We ensure that **Model-based Design (MBD)** seamlessly extends across the entire workflow—from controller development and code generation to real-time operations.
iVH designs Digital Twins for various industrial applications based on **Modelica.**
Unlike visualization-focused digital twins, ours is an **Engineering Digital Twin** specifically designed for design, verification, and operation.
Our expertise spans across diverse sectors, including:
While these may appear to be distinct industries,
they all share a common core: **physics-based system design and integration.**
Modelica serves as the universal language that makes this possible.
iVH does not keep technology as a strictly internal resource.
We take an active role in **expanding the Modelica ecosystem** through:

items: Operating Modelica training programs in Korea.
Providing structured curricula for industrial companies and research institutes.
Delivering practice-oriented modeling and Digital Twin education.

content.text: By doing so, iVH aims to look beyond short-term projects and **elevate the overall standard of Model-based System Engineering across the entire industry.**
iVH is not merely a Modelica expert in a specific sector; we possess **system engineering capabilities** that transcend industrial boundaries.
While our applications continue to expand—from automotive and aerospace to energy, buildings, and robotics—the engineering foundation we rely on remains the same.

Models evolve,
standards accumulate,
and engineering grows stronger.
This is why iVH defines Modelica-based System Engineering as our most vital core capability.
